## 📌 Featured Projects

### 🌍 Wolaita Tourism Platform

**Full-Stack Tourism Management + Sentiment Analysis**

A full-stack tourism platform for discovering destinations, booking tours, managing reviews, and analyzing customer sentiment. It supports multiple user roles, secure payments, multilingual content, and administrative analytics.

**Tech & Architecture:**
`React` `TypeScript` `Vite` `Tailwind CSS` `Firebase` `Node.js` `Express` `Flask` `scikit-learn` `TF-IDF` `Chapa`

🔗 [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/TarikuYe/Full-stack-PERN-Tourism-Management-with-sentiment-analysis) · 🔗 [Live Demo](https://tariku-negesa.vercel.app/) · 📖 [Documentation](https://github.com/TarikuYe/Full-stack-PERN-Tourism-Management-with-sentiment-analysis#readme)

### 🍽️ Smart Digital Hotel & Restaurant Menu

**QR-Based Digital Menu & Restaurant Management**

A modern digital menu system designed for hotels and restaurants, combining QR-accessible menus, multilingual food information, allergen warnings, dietary filters, ordering, feedback, and role-based administration.

**Tech & Architecture:**
`React` `Vite` `Tailwind CSS` `Node.js` `Express.js` `PostgreSQL` `JWT` `RBAC`

🔗 [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/TarikuYe/Digital-Menu-System-for-Hotels-Restaurant) · 🔗 [Live Demo](https://tariku-negesa.vercel.app/) · 📖 [Architecture & Documentation](https://github.com/TarikuYe/Digital-Menu-System-for-Hotels-Restaurant/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md)

---

### ✨ WonderTales AI

**AI-Powered Children's Storytelling Platform**

A product concept and engineering architecture for an AI-powered children's storytelling platform combining personalized stories, illustrations, narration, literacy experiences, and age-appropriate educational features.

**Tech & Architecture:**
`Next.js` `React` `TypeScript` `Tailwind CSS` `shadcn/ui` `Framer Motion` `Supabase` `PostgreSQL` `AI/ML`

🔗 [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/TarikuYe/wondertales-ai) · 🔗 [Portfolio](https://tariku-negesa.vercel.app/) · 📖 [Documentation](https://github.com/TarikuYe/wondertales-ai#readme)

### 📊 Weekly Report Automation System

**Automated Excel Reporting & Workflow Tool**

A Python-based reporting automation tool designed to reduce repetitive manual work by processing department reports, consolidating data, and generating a self-contained Windows executable for easier distribution.

`Python` `Pandas` `OpenPyXL` `Tkinter` `Automation` `Excel` `PyInstaller`
